verdict.rationale: LegalZoom offers an Annual Report service with real-time compliance status updates and a Compliance Calendar with email/deadline reminders (legalzoom-docs-14, -16, -31), implying it helps track and file annual reports, but no evidence explicitly confirms franchise tax filing service or guarantees on-time filing. Missing for 10: explicit franchise tax filing product/process, confirmation of guaranteed on-time filing, and independent/hands-on evidence corroborating annual report filing follow-through.
